system.description:
• Effect: A creature makes its first save to see through each of your illusions with Disadvantage. This is the save for touching, studying or being harmed by an illusion, not a save a spell calls for with "Will negates". Always on.
  • 5th level: a creature that only studies your illusion gets no save unless something gives it clear reason to doubt (GM's call).

rules.value: Convincing Illusions: a creature makes its first save to disbelieve each of your illusions with Disadvantage.
